meta.title: Svadba — wedding planning in North Macedonia
meta.description: Plan guests, budget and checklist in one place, and find restaurants, bands and photo studios with free dates and real prices.

home.title: The whole wedding, planned in one place.
home.lead: Guests by family and side, a budget that shows who pays for what, and restaurants with their free dates and menu prices per person.

couples.title: For the couple
couples.lead: Everything you'd otherwise keep in notebooks, Viber chats and spreadsheets.
couples.guestsText: Group guests by household, mark the bride's or groom's side and age group, and see counts for every event.
couples.budgetText: Track the deposit, installments and due dates, and who pays: you, the families or the кум.
couples.checklistText: From booking the restaurant a year ahead to giving the final guest count, month by month.
couples.seatingText: Long tables, round tables and the head table, arranged on the hall's floor plan.

vendors.title: For restaurants, bands and photo studios
vendors.lead: Listing is free. Show your free dates and prices, and get inquiries from couples who already know their date and guest count.
vendors.venueText: Halls with capacity, menu packages per person and a calendar for each hall.
vendors.bandText: Lineup, packages, extra-hour price and travel fees by city.
vendors.photoText: Packages, portfolio and your calendar of free dates.

footer.made: Made in Macedonia, for Macedonian weddings.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: You'll be signed out everywhere right away. Your account is erased for good after 30 days.
delete.weddingOwner: Your wedding plan passes to your partner (or the first helper who can edit). If there's no one, the plan is erased.
delete.weddingMember: You'll leave the wedding plan; it stays with the couple.
delete.business: “{business}” passes to a team member. If there's no one else on the team, it's hidden from couples.
delete.restore: Changed your mind? Sign in within 30 days and nothing is deleted.

cities.title: Cities

categories.title: Vendor categories
categories.lead: The three launch categories. You can rename them or hide one; new categories come in a later version.

features.title: Venue features
features.lead: Shown as filters in search and as checkboxes on restaurant profiles.

genres.title: Music genres
genres.lead: Bands tick these on their profile. Later they become search filters.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.lead: Review new profiles, and create listings for vendors you're helping.

typicalDay.title: Typical day

We got your request to delete your Svadba account. It will be erased for good on {date}.

Changed your mind? Just sign in before then and nothing is deleted.

It's been almost two years since the wedding of {couple}. To protect your guests' privacy, the guest list, their answers and the seating plan will be erased on {date}.

If you'd like to keep a copy, download your data before then. Your budget and the rest of the plan stay.
email.erasureFooter: You get this email because you're the owner or partner on this wedding plan.

prices.hallsLead: Each hall has its own capacity and its own calendar.

prices.extrasLead: What couples can add: cake, decor, fireworks, extra drinks.

settings.title: Settings

settings.peopleLead: Everyone who helps plan this wedding.

start.title: Who's coming to the wedding?
start.lead: Start with the wedding party and your first guests from both sides. This is just a start: you can change everything later in Guests.

start.placeholderGroom: Name, or a family: Nikolovski: Goran, Elena

invite.title: Invitation
invite.lead: Guests open their link to an envelope with a wax seal. One tap opens it onto your names over your video, a countdown, their part of the day, the places and the RSVP form.
invite.enabledHint: While this is off, guests see the plain RSVP page.
invite.videoUrlHint: A direct link to an MP4 or WebM file that starts with https://. With no upload and no link, the sample video plays.
invite.sampleNote: Showing a sample video for now, from

invite.messageHint: A few words for your guests, shown by the countdown.

invite.overlayHint: Higher washes the video out more, so the frame and text stand out.
invite.detailsNote: Your names and the date come from Settings, and so do each event's time and place.
invite.openAsGuest: Open as a guest sees it
invite.openAsGuestOff: Switch the invitation on and save to see it on the guest page.

invite.musicHint: Starts when the guest taps the seal. They can mute it at any time.
invite.previewMore: Guests then see their part of the day, the places with maps and the RSVP form.
invite.videoFileHint: Upload a clip from your computer or phone: MP4, MOV or WebM, up to {mb} MB. A new upload replaces the old one.
